description.text: A global tech ecosystem for startups located in the heart of the city of Abu Dhabi that brings together key enablers and investors in the region for success.

targetApplicants.text: Ready to take your startup to the next level? We can take you there. When you join Hub71 you are plugged into a community where collaboration thrives. Visionary founders and innovators deploy disruptive technologies in high-growth companies to transform industries. Access the resources, expertise and opportunities you need to accelerate your company’s growth.
